messages:
maria: Quick sync — kicking off a coordinated base-image rebuild to remove setuid bits and add KMS/cosign audit forwarding. Need volunteers for image rebuild, RBAC policy, log exporter for KMS audit events, and a deploy gate change. Who can take what?

sec-bot: Auto-scan on current base: openssh/openssl CVE-2024-ABCD (high), legacy-compat package pulls /usr/bin/su-sudo (medium). cosign signatures present but no external KMS audit forwarding detected.

derek: I can own the rebuild. First step: identify packages that introduce suid. Found legacy-compat and a couple of admin-utils. Plan: rebuild with smaller base (debian-slim -> debian-slim-musl) and remove legacy-compat; provide a tiny compat shim if needed. Will run functional tests against runtime hooks.

nina: I'll draft minimal RBAC for runtime and signer SAs. Proposal: separate SAs for signer vs runtime. Runtime: secretAccessor scoped to image-decrypt-secret and no kms key creation perms; runtime should NOT have signing rights. Signer (CI): CloudKMS CryptoSign only on signing key, guarded by human/ops MFA.

maria: Good. For auditability we need KMS API-level entries exported to customer/cloud audit logs and also app-level structured logs that include ci_run_id and image digest so we can correlate events. Private/on-prem customers need a forwarder option.

ci-bot: Pre-deploy gate changes: add cosign verify step + require CI to attach CI_RUN_ID header. Gate checklist: cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/k1/cryptoKeys/sign-key image:tag; scanner exit code must be clean; no suid bits.

ops-oncall: I'll implement two exporters: 1) GCP logging exporter for Dedicated (pubsub -> Cloud Logging) with sample terraform, 2) a syslog/HTTP forwarder for Private installs that ships KMS audit entries to customer SIEM. ETA: tomorrow 12:00 PST for initial samples.

maria: Can cosign/CI insert metadata on the KMS call so GCP audit logs contain ci_run_id / image_digest fields? We want to avoid manual BigQuery joins.

derek: cosign uses google client libs in CI. We can set gax/metadata or x-goog-request-params with ci_run_id on the signer client. I'll prototype a tiny wrapper that injects metadata before signing.

nina: Note: injecting headers is fine for correlation, but do not rely on them for auth. RBAC must still enforce key principals. We'll include a caveat in the policy doc.

sec-bot: Reminder: new image will be rescanned automatically once pushed. Marked for high-priority re-scan after rebuild.

sarah: Canary/rollout idea: publish a signed canary tag, route 1% traffic, monitor error budget, cosign verify metrics, and KMS audit-forwarder logs for AsymmetricSign/Decrypt events. If any missing audit events or permission denies occur, trigger automatic rollback and page eng-sre.

ops-oncall: Incident playbook draft (high level):
- failed cosign verify during deploy -> immediate rollback + alert to eng-sre + fail pipeline.
- runtime KMS permission denied -> fail closed: deny decrypt, send structured alert, create retry queue for re-encrypt with fallback key (operator approval required).
- unexpected KMS key usage without matching CI_RUN_ID -> investigation runbook, freeze related pipelines.
I'll attach a detailed playbook to the docs repo when ready.

maria: Nice. A few constraints: +Signer SA must be distinct and kept offlineable (MFA ops gate), +Runtime SA should be least-privilege and replaceable, +We must block unsigned images at deploy-bot.

nina: RBAC snippet (will commit to policy repo):
- role: roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor
  members:
  - serviceAccount:runtime-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
  members:
  - serviceAccount:runtime-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoSignerVerifier
  members:
  - serviceAccount:image-signer-ci@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Comments: signer gets Sign, runtime only Decrypt for runtime-encryption keys. No key admin perms.

derek: I'll strip setuid out of the build and publish an unsigned test image for staging first, then a signed canary. Expect initial builds by EOD.

maria: Action items and owners:
- derek: rebuild base without suid + test images (owner)
- nina: finalize RBAC and policy snippets + docs (owner)
- ops-oncall: implement log exporters + deploy-bot cosign hook (owner)
- ci-bot: add cosign verify + header injection gate (owner)
- sarah: define canary metrics & rollback thresholds (owner)
Please ack when you have it.

derek: ack. Starting package pruning now.

nina: ack. Will push policy PR today.

ops-oncall: ack. Will drop samples to the playbook repo when ready.

ci-bot: ack. Will open MR to inject CI_RUN_ID header and cosign verify step.

maria: Thanks team — keep this thread updated. If the canary shows missing KMS audit lines, escalate immediately.

[thread end]
